notes: Reached via Chrome directly, no block encountered; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. HipVan is a Singapore-founded furniture retailer (homepage: 'Shop Furniture in Singapore | Online Home Furniture Store') with dedicated top-nav departments Sofas, Dining, Beds, Furniture (general storage/chairs/tables/outdoor/pet), Kids, plus non-furniture Mattresses/Lightings/Decor/Rugs/Soft Furnishings/Kitchen/Electronics (excluded). Tree source: each department landing page renders a 'Shop by Category' chip strip (site's own sub-category tiles) plus a breadcrumb '(N items)' count on every listing page (Home > Dept > [Parent >] Leaf (N items)); this breadcrumb count was the qty source throughout, cross-checked as internally consistent across the session. Deepest-node rule applied: seat-count facets (4/6/8/10-Seater), shape facets (Round), and material facets (Wooden/Metal/Concrete/Sintered Stone/Leather/Fabric/Velvet) under Dining Tables/Sets, Sofas and Beds were treated as filter re-cuts of their parent node (same pattern as price/colour filters) and excluded, keeping only the parent (e.g. 'All Dining Tables' 158 items, not the 10 seater-count/material sub-cuts). Genuine distinct product-type nodes (Sofa Sets, Armchairs & Ottomans, Recliner Sofas, Sofa Beds, Modular Sofas, Outdoor Sofas; Dining Chairs/Benches/Stools/Bar-Counter-Stools; Storage/Adjustable/Wall/Divan/Bunk/Headboard Beds) were kept as separate leaves. Cross-department duplicate handling (verified via breadcrumb+count, not name alone, per the label-vs-slug trap): the site cross-lists several node types under multiple department trees with slightly different counts (stock/tagging drift, not distinct catalogues) -- e.g. Dining Chairs read 119 items under Furniture>Chairs but 116 under Dining>All Dining Chairs&Stools; Wardrobes read 24 under Furniture>Storage but 25 under Beds>Bedroom Furniture. In every such case ONE canonical placement was kept and the duplicate dropped: Dining-specific items (chairs/tables) kept under Dining, not the Furniture>Chairs/Tables echo; Sofa Beds kept under Sofas, not the Beds>sofa-beds-3 echo; storage items (Wardrobes/Chest of Drawers/Bedside Tables/Dressing Tables/Clothes Racks) kept under Furniture>Storage/Tables, not the Beds>'Bedroom Furniture' echo (which had zero non-duplicate children); Kids Beds kept under Kids (94 items), not the Beds>kids-beds-1 echo. Excluded as out-of-scope after inspecting page titles/products: Mattresses, Pet Beds & Accessories (pet, not human furniture) under both Furniture>Pet Furniture and Beds, Outdoor BBQ Grills (appliance) under Furniture>Outdoor, Furniture Disposal (service) under Furniture>Tables, Bedding/Duvets/Pillows/Mattress&Pillow Protectors under Beds, Toy Storage & Play Mats under Kids (storage bins + rugs, not furniture), Kids Mats & Rugs/Kids Lighting/Kids Wall Art/Kids Toys/brand pages under Kids. Kids > Baby Cots & Beddings (81 items) is flagged MANUAL REVIEW: the site has no separate URL splitting Baby Cots (furniture) from Beddings (textile) -- included per the project's 'Beds & Mattresses, no split' precedent. Massage Chairs correctly read '(1 item)' singular, not the 'items)' plural pattern; caught by direct string search. Wall Shelves (20 items, titled 'Floating Shelves, Wall Rack & Cabinet') and Outdoor Storage (69 items, titled 'Outdoor Storage Cabinet ... Waterproof Storage') were verified via page title as genuine storage-furniture cabinets/shelving, not decorative wall shelves or plain storage bins, and kept per the site's own Furniture>Storage classification. No sanity-check disagreements found (counts changed appropriately between categories, no suspiciously round display caps, breadcrumb h1 matched requested slug on every page visited).
